text:
This is a new Summary Stage chapter for cases diagnosed 2023+.

For cases diagnosed prior to 2023+, use the appropriate Summary Stage chapter based on primary site

C700, C710-C719: Summary Stage Chapter Brain
C701, C709, C720-C729: Summary Stage Chapter CNS Other
C753: Summary Stage Chapter Intracranial Gland
Benign (/0) or Borderline (/1) tumors are always coded to 8 regardless of size, extension to adjacent sites, or multiple tumors
Codes 0, 3, and 4 are not applicable for this chapter.

SUMMARY STAGE 1 Localized only (Localized, NOS)

Single tumor with no invasion or seeding to other structures
Confined to site of origin, NOS
Localized, NOS
